name: select
gotchas: mat-select is designed to live inside a `<mat-form-field>` — it renders its trigger/label/underline through the form field's styling and layout, it isn't a standalone control the way a native `<select>` is.

Binding `[compareWith]` is required when option values are objects rather than primitives, or the selected option stops highlighting correctly once the bound value is reassigned to a new object with the same shape.
`multiple` changes the bound value's type from a single value to an array — toggling the `multiple` input after the value is already bound to a scalar throws at runtime rather than coercing.
